description: This file defines the ResultSet class for User entities in a database schema, including methods for validation, querying, and filtering user data such as email validation, username availability, and token status.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::User
classes.description: ResultSet class for user-related database queries, extending the base ResultSet with custom methods for user validation and filtering.

methods.name: email_valid_and_available
methods.description: Checks if an email is valid, not blacklisted, and not already associated with an existing user or pending token.

methods.name: name_available
methods.description: Checks if a username is available by ensuring it is not in the blacklist and not used by existing organizations or users.

methods.name: site_owners
methods.description: Retrieves users with the role of 'site_owner'.

methods.name: with_projects_count
methods.description: Retrieves users along with a count of their associated projects.

methods.name: with_valid_limited_token
methods.description: Filters users with a valid, non-expired limited token.

methods.name: with_valid_or_unlimited_token
methods.description: Filters users with either an unlimited token or a valid, non-expired token.
